name: Getting Started with Claude Code CLI
outcome: Complete and verify a bounded repository change using one coding agent.
description: Use Claude Code CLI to make a small, controlled scientific software change. Learn session setup, permissions, model and context settings, task specification, and independent review. Choose this or the other CLI course, not both.
external: Basic programming, Git, command-line use and software execution; an approved coding agent.
prior: Basic Python, Git and terminal use
Access to the selected CLI and an approved model/service
learn: Configure Claude Code CLI with approved access and least-privilege controls
Specify a bounded task with relevant project instructions and acceptance criteria
Review the resulting change, run independent tests and record provenance
moduleDescriptions: Distinguish models from agents; configure Claude Code CLI, authenticate and inspect a sample repository.
Check permission and sandbox settings, model selection and context limits before allowing changes.
Write a bounded task with acceptance criteria; use CLAUDE.md and review a plan before editing.
Implement one scientific code change; inspect diffs, run tests and record the configuration.
practice: Use the same Lotka–Volterra repository and feature as S01-O, using Claude Code instead.
acceptance: Identical acceptance criteria to S01-O: reviewed plan, bounded permissions, correct result, passing supplied tests, reviewed diff and recorded configuration.
prerequisiteRationale: F02 establishes prompt design and output limitations; CLI operation is taught here.
